SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT C.*, O.ORGNAME AS SAMPLEORGNAME, L.ORGNAME AS REPORTEDITORGNAME, P.ORGNAME AS REPORTSENDORGNAME, STUFF((SELECT ',' + ORGNAME FROM T_EMC_ORG_PERMISSION A WHERE A.TARGETID = C.ID AND A.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY' FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS ORGNAMES FROM T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY C LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON C.SAMPLEORGID = O.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG L ON C.REPORTEDITORGID = L.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG P ON C.REPORTSENDORGID = P.ID) T
ORDER BY
1 = 1 /* 系统管理员:单位权限 */
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORG_PERMISSION OP_ WHERE OP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY' AND OP_.TARGETID = T.ID AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP_ WHERE UP_.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND UP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP_.TARGETID = OP_.ORGID))
T.ORDERNO ASC, T.ID DESC

SELECT T.*, O.ORGNAME AS SAMPLEORGNAME, L.ORGNAME AS REPORTEDITORGNAME, P.ORGNAME AS REPORTSENDORGNAME FROM T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY T LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON T.SAMPLEORGID = O.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG L ON T.REPORTEDITORGID = L.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG P ON T.REPORTSENDORGID = P.ID WHERE T.ID = #{id}
